item.title: Keep Her Centred in Portrait

turns.text: Make this landscape clip vertical, 9:16. Keep her centred throughout and keep the full 10 seconds with the original sound. No captions.

item.tests: Tests portrait reframing of existing footage while preserving the speaker, duration and source audio.

answer_sheet.Source and subject: Use talk-one.mp4 and keep the woman centred.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, the full 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Framing style: Crop to fill the frame without stretching; keep her face and head comfortably visible.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Keep the original speech and sound. No captions or other added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 video using the attached woman's actual footage, not a newly generated recreation.
The woman remains horizontally centred with her face and head comfortably visible throughout.
The picture fills the portrait frame without stretching or black bars.
The full 10-second sequence and original speech are retained in sync.
No captions or other text have been added.

dialog.agent: Sure—what would you like changed in the clip? For example, add subtitles, change the background or visual style, or adjust something specific.
dialog.why: It asks the user what changes they want to the clip and waits for their input.
dialog.user: make it vertical and keep the woman centred, the full 10 seconds with the original sound. no captions

dialog.agent:
You want a **9:16 vertical crop**, with the woman kept centred, the **full 10 seconds and original sound**, and no captions.

I can’t reliably make that exact edit with the connected tools: the video editor regenerates footage rather than providing a crop-only operation with guaranteed original-audio preservation.

In a standard video editor, set the canvas to **9:16**, use subject-tracking auto-reframe on the woman, and leave the original audio and 0:00–0:10 timeline unchanged.
dialog.why: It says the connected tools cannot reliably perform the exact crop-only edit while preserving the original audio, and offers manual editing guidance instead.

turns.agent: I tried, but Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits. No video was generated and no credits were spent.
